meta.title: Counter offer during evaluation time on one of the two lines; the vendor accepts
gaps: An existing RFQ in evaluation with two lines where Vendor A quoted 100 and 50; the prepared state provides a closed two-bid event with one line instead.
Verifying that only line 1 is countered while line 2 remains at 50.
Verifying Master QCS totals across both lines after acceptance.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: An existing RFQ in evaluation with two lines where Vendor A quoted 100 and 50; the prepared state provides a closed two-bid event with one line instead.; Verifying that only line 1 is countered while line 2 remains at 50.; Verifying Master QCS totals across both lines after acceptance.

steps.note: Open the prepared event's buyer Responses screen; prepared-state rules require this as the first step.
Ensure RFQ counter offers are available.
Ensure eRFX project functionality is enabled for the case.

args.remark: Counter offer on the selected line

steps.note: Send the closest expressible counter offer on Vendor A's normal bid; the prepared event has one line, so a line-1-only selection cannot be specified.
Verify the buyer's Responses grid marks Vendor A's bid as having a counter offer.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier portal and accept the pending counter offer.
Verify the buyer-side Responses grid marks Vendor A's counter offer as accepted.
Open the buyer's Master QCS after acceptance and verify Vendor A is present.
Verify the available line reflects the accepted countered price.
Verify Master QCS arithmetic for the available line and its total.
